questions.text: Outline any concerns regarding the impact of the Acquisition on competition, including if Johns Lyng Group and C&M Build Group are close competitors and there are not many alternatives or if one is a major supplier to competitors of the other.
Provide a brief description of your business or organisation, including any commercial relationships with Johns Lyng Group and/or C&M Build Group.
Provide any additional information or comments on any barriers that might exist for general construction, repair or building companies to provide services to insurers or insurance loss adjusters.
Provide any additional information or comments that you consider relevant to the ACCC’s assessment of the Acquisition.
